title: Reject late Skill results after cancellation
goal: Ensure a Skill executor result cannot be returned as success if cancellation arrives while executor code is suspended.
context: SkillRuntime.execute checks cancellation immediately before invoking an executor but directly returns the awaited executor result. A registered executor that does not cooperate with cancellation can finish later and have its output returned after the caller cancelled.
forbidden_changes: Do not claim cancellation can undo side effects already performed by an executor.
Do not change policy, executor selection, schema, or UI behavior beyond cancellation completion semantics.
Do not report late executor output as verified success.
acceptance_criteria: SkillRuntime checks cancellation after awaiting executor execution and before returning output.
A regression test uses a non-cooperative executor to prove late output is rejected after cancellation.
Existing registered and module-backed executor behavior remains covered.
verification: Check Swift package tests + repository integrity and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if cancellation behavior regresses normal Skill execution; keep executor side-effect rollback as a separate concern.
